decisions.reason: The location-based margin analysis builds directly on the firm's maintained tariff and network market-data databases and its calculation know-how, and it kept its own page in 2024, so the firm can interpret its results and keep refining it within its central platform.

The regional electricity tariff calculator sits close to the firm's core tariff-data competence, so the firm is likely to keep it, possibly folded into the platform, even though it was downgraded to a mention in 2024 and the related gas and energy tariff products were removed.

The regional area definition tool draws on the firm's geographic network-area data and supports its other location-based tools, so it likely survives as an integrated platform component despite having lost its own page in 2024.
